title: Design guidelines for Private Wealth Management & Family Office

sections.section-content: Private Wealth Management & Family Office  is part of the SEB brand, but our clients expect a more refined experience. We always follow SEB's core design principles, including the SEB green colour and SEB Sans Serif, while making a few considered choices to create a more premium look and feel.

sections.title: Our guiding principles
sections.section-content: Everything we make should look and feel refined, with a higher level of attention to detail.

columns.title: Premium
columns.content: Does it feel considered and refined? Every detail should feel intentional, from the choice of image and words to spacing, layout and finish.

columns.title: International
columns.content: Would it feel relevant in an international context? Our communication should have a global outlook and contemporary expression, reflecting the world our clients live and operate in.

columns.title: Crisp
columns.content: Is the message immediately clear? Remove anything that does not add value. Keep the language concise and the design clean.

sections.title: Images
sections.section-content:
Our images set the tone and overall feel. They are high-quality, inspirational and often shot in international settings, reflecting an active and healthy lifestyle that resonates with our target audience. 

Compared with SEB's broader imagery, our images have a more international and lifestyle-led expression. Locations and situations are carefully chosen to feel relevant and recognisable to our clients, while remaining natural and recognisably SEB.

Combined with a strong written message, they create a solid foundation for distinctive and impactful communication.

We never use AI imagery at PWM&FO.

columns.label: Read our guidelines

columns.content:
We have specific templates for our PWM&FO presentation and sales material – you find it in the New Document-dialgue in PowerPoint. Make sure to not overcrowd the layout when using the template or designing your own.

White is your friend – use white space and try to maintain a calm and focused design. Please contact [DesignHub](PWMFO_Design_Hub@seb.se) who will help with polishing client-facing presentation material.

columns.caption: Do utilize provided templates and guidelines.
Don't use unbranded imagery, typefaces or colors.
Don't overcrowd the layout with too much information.

columns.title: SEB SansSerif
columns.content:
SEB SansSerif is a font designed exclusively for SEB.

In daily use, we use SEB SansSerif Regular for PWM&FO use, in contrast to SansSerif Book for the rest of the bank.  
Bold is exclusively used for sub headlines – never for headlines. 

[Read more about SEB SansSerif](https://seb.io/brand/typography)

columns.title: Wulkan Display
columns.content:
To further elevate the design, PWM&FO also has access to the exclusive typeface *Wulkan Display*. It should never be the main typeface of any design. Instead, use it for selected parts of headlines, numbers or to personalise messages, like how you would normally use italics.

Both SEB SansSerif and Wulkan Display are pre-installed on your computer if you are a PWM&FO employee.

dolist.text: Do use Wulkan for concept titles, in event names and for other conceptualized content.
Do highlight parts of headlines, numbers or names using Wulkan. This works particularly well when applied to messages that should feel personal and exclusive.

dontlist.text: Don't use Wulkan for regular headlines and body texts – this does not look like SEB.

sections.title: PowerPoint template
sections.section-content:
The custom template is pre-made with a higher level of refinement in mind. It supports creating open, approachable, and elevated presentations. These layouts use elements that, when used together, create some differentiation from the general SEB brand, but still align with the SEB brand principles.

Remember to always personalise your client facing presentations, and to keep them short and punchy. On the screen, clarity and directness are key to effective communication. 

These PowerPoint presentation slide templates are modular, meaning you will never use all slides in one presentation, but customize only with the slides you need for a specific meeting.

You’ll find the PWM&FO PowerPoint template as well as the general SEB PowerPoint templates when you open PowerPoint and start a new document.

[Download PPT from PWMFO workspace](https://intra.sebank.se/en/workspaces/wealth-and-asset-management/pwmfo/).

columns.title: Elements only present in the PWM&FO template
columns.content:
- A generous and open layout system with a lot of white space makes the presentation more focused.
- Images with rounded corners create a more distinct look than you get from general PowerPoint presentations
- The use of Wulkan in some slides

sections.title: A tactile experience
sections.section-content: The feeling of quality is not just a matter of how information is presented graphically, but also the physical feeling of holding it in your hand. Whenever we produce physical media, we make an effort to pick high-quality materials, premium paper, and a finer finish. Debossed and lacquered print finishes can be used for a more refined design.

sections.title: Colour
sections.section-content: We use the SEB brand colours, and in the same way – with a focus on white and our own green, *SEB Green Senior*, as our leading brand colour. However, all PWM&FO material should have an extra level of sophistication, and this applies to colour too – use colour sparingly.

sections.title: Rounded corners
sections.section-content:
A good way to make a design stand out and make it more distinct is to treat images with an extra element of care. Rounding the corners of images gives them an extra presence in presentation and sales material. Do this whenever you place an image in a presentation or sales material. 

Rounded corners aren’t exclusive for PWM&FO but should be done consistently in all PWM&FO communication. It'll give the material an extra level of refinement and attention to detail.

Learn how to round corners in PowerPoint [here](https://brand.seb.se/original/gallery/12864/files/original/1ddb5f14-3120-4e3f-a0d8-f832fc25257f.png)

sections.title: SEB General and PWM&FO design comparison

columns.title: General layout
columns.content: Accessible and modern. General customer facing imagery. Easy to navigate.

columns.title: PWM&FO Layout
columns.content:
- The layout is less conventional and with a more white space, giving it a more elevated appearance.
- Rounded corners of the image adds to the bespoke look.
- SEB SansSerif Regular instead of Book helps lightening the design.

columns.title: General layout
columns.content: Standard layout, accessible text sizes and SEB general graph colors. Focus on navigation and clarity.

columns.title: PWM&FO Layout
columns.content:
- A more generous layout with more white space. Smaller text sizes and SEB SansSerif Regular giva a lighter look.
- Wulkan Regular used in part of headline that points to the customer, making it feel more personalized.
- Colours are used more sparingly to create a calmer and more sophisticated design.
